'''12 April 2026 San Diego retro tournament''' was an eight-player [[Premiere - Death Star II]] tournament on the Sunday of the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]]. [[Eddie Szwabowski]] won it undefeated, with a 4-0 record and 8 victory points.<ref name="congrats">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1493084641182089396 Congrats to Eddie for taking first place with a 4-0 performance!], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (13 April 2026).</ref><ref name="standings">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1493084560097939506 Sunday retro standings], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (13 April 2026).</ref>

redv announced it on 2 February 2026 as a retro tournament at the San Diego Super Open of 10–12 April, in Premiere through Death Star II.<ref name="announce">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1468028767900270795 Announcing a Retro Tournament at the San Diego Super Open April 10-12], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (2 February 2026).</ref> On 2 March 2026 the announced plan was one deck for the day.<ref name="samedeck">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1478097369814929448 Same deck for the day], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (2 March 2026).</ref> Eight players competed. Two last-minute cancellations kept the field at eight.<ref name="recap">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1493737828771823747 San Diego retro tournament recap], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (14 April 2026).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 12 April 2026
* '''Event:''' Sunday retro tournament at the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Deck:''' one deck for the day<ref name="samedeck" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Eddie Szwabowski]]

The recap names the winner as Nrabbit and Mike's GEMP handle as themikeguy, fourth at 2-2.<ref name="recap" /> redv's caption of the group photograph names Mark as techmo_r.<ref name="names">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1493796740539875458 Group photograph names], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (15 April 2026).</ref>

== Prizes ==

Announced prize support was $100 for first, $50 for second, and $25 for third and fourth, plus a Premiere dark-side rare uncut sheet for one random player who finished every game.<ref name="prizes">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1478219192585945242 Sunday Retro prize support], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (3 March 2026).</ref> techmo_r received that uncut Premiere dark-side rare sheet. The sheet was a random participation prize, not the tournament result.<ref name="recap" /> On 2 May 2026, Nrabbit said the Players Committee had sent him $100 for the event.<ref name="pc100">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1500166395407892560 The PC just sent me $100 for this event], Nrabbit, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (2 May 2026).</ref>

The recap thanks imrahil327 and the other volunteers for the event, batmouse and BrenDerlin for Sunday food, and B Silk WOOO, Veers, and techmo_r for additional prizes.<ref name="recap" />
